title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?

claims.claim: PHP, Wiz adlı siber güvenlik firmasına göre dünyanın web sitelerinin %70'ini güçlendirmektedir.

evidence.quote: According to cyber-security firm Wiz, which helped uncover the critical PHP vulnerabilities surfaced this week, PHP powers 70% of the world's websites.

claims.claim: PHP'deki kritik güvenlik açıklarına CVE-2026-109618 ve CVE-2026-109619 teknik kimlikleri verilmiştir.

evidence.quote: The technical bugs, given the technical IDs CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, were ranked a 9.2 out of 10 in severity by researchers.

claims.claim: PHP'deki teknik açılar araştırmacılar tarafından 10 üzerinden 9.2 şiddetinde derecelendirilmiştir.

evidence.quote: The technical bugs, given the technical IDs CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, were ranked a 9.2 out of 10 in severity by researchers.

claims.claim: PHP Foundation, yazılımdaki güvenlik açıklarını gidermek için 21 Ekim Çarşamba günü yamalar yayınlamıştır.

evidence.quote: The PHP Foundation rolled out patches on Wednesday to fix the vulnerabilities that had been lurking in their software for years.

claims.claim: İngiltere Hükümeti, ihtiyati tedbir olarak 32 sitesini geçici olarak kapattığını açıklamıştır.

evidence.quote: It said 32 sites had been taken down as a precaution, none of them large public-facing services.
The UK Government revealed on Thursday some "limited" services may be offline temporarily. It said 32 sites had been taken down as a precaution, none of them large public-facing services.

claims.claim: Cloudflare yöneticisi Matthew Prince, duyurudan sonraki saatlerde ağında milyonlarca istismar girişimi gördüğünü belirtmiştir.

evidence.quote: Matthew Prince, the boss of internet infrastructure firm Cloudflare, also said it had seen "thousands" of attempts to exploit the PHP vulnerabilities across its network in the 10 hours before it was publicly announced.
"That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now," he wrote on X, external.

Matthew Prince, the boss of internet infrastructure firm Cloudflare, also said it had seen "thousands" of attempts to exploit the PHP vulnerabilities across its network in the 10 hours before it was publicly announced. "That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now,"

claims.claim: Calif and Wiz araştırmacıları, PHP'deki açıkları bulmak için OpenAI tarafından geliştirilen yapay zeka araçlarını kullanmıştır.
PHP, 1990'ların başlarında dinamik web sayfalarına ve uygulamalarına yardımcı olmak için geliştirilmiştir.

evidence.quote: Developed in the early 1990s to help serve dynamic web pages and applications, PHP still powers lots of platforms today, including Wikipedia, online shops and WordPress â the system behind many websites.
